title: Attack
desc: After a terror attack leaves Arjun paralysed and grieving his lover, he joins a radical experiment when the attacker resurfaces, seeking revenge and a chance to fight back.

title: Andha Kanoon
desc: Witnesses to the killing of his parents by three men called Amar, Akbar and Anthony, Vijay teams up with a former forest officer to take revenge.

title: Josh
desc: 2 gangs, Bichhoo, led by Prakash and Eagles by Max fight for power. Prakash's brother Rahul and Shirley, sister of Max are in love.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: A young woman, duped and sold to a brothel, rises above despair. Using underworld connections, she transforms from pawn to ruler, commanding power in a ruthless world.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Kantara: A Legend Chapter-1
desc: Set in pre-colonial Karnataka under the Kadamba dynasty, Bhuta Kola emerges as a sacred ritual, even as the legend of Kaadubettu Shiva quietly begins to take shape.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

title: Bamfaad
desc: Nasir, a reckless politician's son, falls for Neelam, a rival's mistress. Their affair sparks a violent feud that spirals into bloodshed and political chaos.

title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

title: Humjoli
desc: Gopaldas marries heiress Roopa to get rich. His greed spirals out of control when he plots her murder to inherit her wealth.

title: Madgaon Express
desc: Childhood friends Dodo, Ayush, and Pinku head to Goa for fun, but a chain of impulsive choices, wild detours, and hilariously bad decisions turns their dream trip into total chaos.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary reunites with a British officer he once shared a bond with. Together, they set aside differences to fight despotic rulers, forging an inspiring path to freedom.

title: Khatta Meetha
desc: Sachin, a contractor, sues the Satara Municipal Corporation for unpaid dues. His ex-girlfriend, now the commissioner, seeks revenge while a bridge collapse and legal troubles escalate his problems.

title: Baby John
desc: DCP Satya Verma fakes his death to shield his daughter from a deadly politician. But when enemies return, he must face his past to protect his family at all costs.

title: Vijaypath
desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

title: Karz
desc: Monty learns the shocking truth of his past life-betrayed and killed by his greedy wife, leaving his family homeless. With his lover's support, he vows to set things right.
